## What needs correcting?

Describe the claim, file, or section that appears wrong or out of date.

## Source

Link the current source, regulator guidance, standard, professional guidance, vendor documentation, or internal-reference repo.

## Suggested change

What should the playbook say instead?

## Sensitivity check

Do not include board-confidential, client, customer, employee, HR, payroll, financial, legal, strategy, M&A, incident, security, confidential, regulated, proprietary, credential, or personal information.
